## Ingredients

| Ingredient | Amount |
| --- | --- |
| All-purpose flour | 1.25 cups |
| Cold unsalted butter, cubed | 8 tbsp |
| Ice water | 3 tbsp |
| Blueberries | 3 cups |
| Granulated sugar | 1/3 cup |
| Cornstarch | 1 tbsp |
| Lemon zest | 1 tsp |

## Instructions

1. Cut the butter into the flour until pea-sized, then bind with ice water.
2. Chill the dough one hour, then roll into a rough 12 inch round.
3. Toss the blueberries with sugar, cornstarch and zest and mound in the centre.
4. Fold the border over the fruit and bake at 400F for 40 minutes.
